security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI M-mode writes SPMP entries via miselect/mireg/mireg2 indirect CSR accesses (e.g., to sandbox S-mode, restore SPMP state on HSM resume, or clear locked SPMP entries) and then executes MRET to S-mode or relies on those SPMP protections for subsequent M-mode memory accesses without first executing SFENCE.VMA with rs1=x0 and rs2=x0
security_spec.summary: SPMP CSR writes via miselect/mireg/mireg2 are explicitly unordered with respect to subsequent memory accesses; missing SFENCE.VMA before MRET allows S-mode to execute with stale or unenforced SPMP protections, undermining M-mode sandboxing
